notes:
Background: CascadeQuill builds an AI-assistant for mid-market B2B SaaS product teams (in-app help + docs search + triage summarization). Ran a 6-week Hosted API trial (Nov–Dec 2025) to validate UX and quality. Trial summary: product PM really liked response quality but ops flagged latency variability and cost spikes on heavy user days.

Hosted trial metrics (sample): p95 latency 520ms for short queries, p95 1.8s for long context requests; average request size 220 tokens; peak observed QPS 90 during a promotional event; sustained QPS baseline ~30. Logged token churn from multi-turn support flows (many short prompts then long follow-ups).

Why Redwood: liked transparent perf benchmarks and built-in batching/kv caching. Primary ask now is a Dedicated sizing conversation: they want an authoritative capacity worksheet showing how many GPUs and what instance types to reserve for predictable SLOs (target p50 latency <=120ms for short prompts, p95 <700ms for mixed workload). Also want recommended autoscale/burst policy and estimated monthly bill for 150 QPS sustained vs spike profile.

POC & pricing: AE Jordan + SE Priya ran an internal sizing workshop 2026-02-18 (ff_2026-02-18_8432). Product lead (Maya Chen) said: "We need predictable latency during peak support hours — if the model slows, our CSAT tanks." Engineering wants a fallback routing policy to cheaper quantized models when Dedicated pool is saturated. They also care about data residency for EU enterprise customers (legal asked for explicit audit logs and KMS integration).

Operational requirements: VPC deployment for private networking, SOC2 compliance required for procurement, SSO via SAML, ability to export audit logs to their SIEM, monthly retention policy for conversation logs (90 days).

Conversation snippets: "Can we run a week-long Dedicated pilot at reduced committed capacity to validate traffic patterns?" — Maya Chen.

Next steps (short): 1) AE to deliver Dedicated capacity worksheet with two sizing options (cost-optimized vs latency-optimized) by 2026-03-12. 2) SE to map current Hosted logs to Redwood sizing template (QPS, seq_len histograms, token mix) — owners: Priya + CQ eng lead (Rafi Gomez). 3) Security to complete questionnaire; Redwood security FAQ link provided in Drive. 4) Schedule PO for 2-week Dedicated pilot (if sizing aligns).

Useful links: pricing deck, security FAQ, and the Hosted trial log export in Drive (see linked_drive_docs).
